title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a talented and visionary Product Designer with a strong command of user interface design to elevate the intuitive nature and value of our SaaS platform through innovative designs rooted in customer feedback.


About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedulethat are directly aligned with customer needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.


What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.


At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

title: Business Analyst I, IT Delivery
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The IT Delivery Business Analyst (BA) will work closely with IT Delivery leadership and stakeholders in order to provide strategic planning for various project requests and gather, analyze, and document business requirements that will support cross-functional project execution. This position will work in a support role and alongside various individuals of all levels and departments, and must be comfortable in a technical setting, communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.


Responsibilities

  • Investigate and understand the fundamental business needs, process frameworks, and supporting technologies in order to interpret and define business and functional requirements
  • Assist stakeholders in defining project scope
  • Work with IT resources to define functional approaches and high level scopes of work
  • Identify and document business risks, impacts, and mitigation options based on requirements
  • Effectively define and present project requirements and process flows via various formats – including workflow diagrams, use cases, business requirements documents, process framework documents, verbal presentations, etc.
  • Secure business and functional requirements approval from business and technical stakeholders
  • Write test cases and coordinate with development/QA teams to ensure business requirements are met
  • Coordinate with project managers to meet BA deliverable expectations and schedules
  • Provide team members, stakeholders, and project managers with concise and accurate status updates regarding progress and action items
  • Schedule, participate in, and lead discovery meetings
  • Capture detailed notes/meeting minutes from discovery and review calls
  • Manage multiple assignments simultaneously


Requirements

  • Minimum 0 – 2 years of business analysis experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS/CS, Business Administration, or related field or equivalent work experience
  • Strong analytical skills, displaying ability to quickly understand new information and problem solve
  • Ability to productively work both independently on assigned tasks and collaborate with a team on larger efforts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Proficiency in MS Office tools – such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies – including Agile and Waterfall – and tools – such as MS Project, Jira, ADO, etc.
  • Exposure to IT spaces related to order management systems, data processing tools, or infrastructure services


Benefits :

  • R$340 home office allowance
  • ️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)
  • 10% annual bonus
  • SulAmérica health/dental plan

title: Business Analyst I, IT Delivery
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The IT Delivery Business Analyst (BA) will work closely with IT Delivery leadership and stakeholders in order to provide strategic planning for various project requests and gather, analyze, and document business requirements that will support cross-functional project execution. This position will work in a support role and alongside various individuals of all levels and departments, and must be comfortable in a technical setting, communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.


Responsibilities

  • Investigate and understand the fundamental business needs, process frameworks, and supporting technologies in order to interpret and define business and functional requirements
  • Assist stakeholders in defining project scope
  • Work with IT resources to define functional approaches and high level scopes of work
  • Identify and document business risks, impacts, and mitigation options based on requirements
  • Effectively define and present project requirements and process flows via various formats – including workflow diagrams, use cases, business requirements documents, process framework documents, verbal presentations, etc.
  • Secure business and functional requirements approval from business and technical stakeholders
  • Write test cases and coordinate with development/QA teams to ensure business requirements are met
  • Coordinate with project managers to meet BA deliverable expectations and schedules
  • Provide team members, stakeholders, and project managers with concise and accurate status updates regarding progress and action items
  • Schedule, participate in, and lead discovery meetings
  • Capture detailed notes/meeting minutes from discovery and review calls
  • Manage multiple assignments simultaneously


Requirements

  • Minimum 0 – 2 years of business analysis experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS/CS, Business Administration, or related field or equivalent work experience
  • Strong analytical skills, displaying ability to quickly understand new information and problem solve
  • Ability to productively work both independently on assigned tasks and collaborate with a team on larger efforts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Proficiency in MS Office tools – such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies – including Agile and Waterfall – and tools – such as MS Project, Jira, ADO, etc.
  • Exposure to IT spaces related to order management systems, data processing tools, or infrastructure services


Benefits :

  • R$340 home office allowance
  • ️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)
  • 10% annual bonus
  • SulAmérica health/dental plan

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno



Resumo:

Pessoa será responsável por garantir a manutenção dos produtos e processos correntes, atuando também continuamente em busca de melhorias metodológicas, processuais e em qualidade. Além disso, se posiciona como ponto focal para atendimento de dúvidas dos times de Produto, Operações e Comercial, suportando também testes, documentações e estudos de novos processos.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Promover a contínua comunicação com os principais stakeholders internos para a manutenção dos critérios técnicos na sustentabilidade dos processos recorrentes nos produtos.
  • Garantir em metodologia e execução a manutenção de processos já validados e em operação nos produtos em que o time possui atuação.
  • Atuar nas inclusões, revisões e atualizações metodológicas propostas pelo time e/ou demandadas por Produto e Comercial dos processos relacionados com métodos de integração de dados para os produtos do Portfólio.
  • Mapear, desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de análises e testes de novos processos dos produtos de Audiência de TV e Cross Media.
  • Propor e desenvolver controles de qualidade com o objetivo de garantir e certificar o pleno funcionamento de etapas de processos internos e/ou externos associados aos produtos e cobertos pelo escopo do time.
  • Mapear oportunidades em que a automação pode promover melhora significativa na qualidade e/ ou eficiência de processos.
  • Propor e desenvolver técnicas e aplicações de automação para atividades recorrentes na equipe ou executadas por áreas de interface e que impactem os processos da equipe.
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o mercado de Inteligência Artificial, com objetivo de identificar e implementar soluções que visem inovação, melhoria e/ou eficiência.
  • Fomentar de forma constante a inovação e melhoria contínua em temas relacionados à área, estando constantemente ativo na busca e curadoria de novas práticas e aberto a ouvir propostas de outros membros da equipe.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento de cada membro da equipe, estando sempre disponível para troca de ideias, explicações e compartilhamento de conhecimento.




O que buscamos?

  • Formação Superior em Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência na indústria de publicidade e/ou mídia.
  • Fundamental experiência em linguagens de programação como Python e R.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados integradas ao Python, R ou como o Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas para uso de dados em nuvem, como Azure Databricks.
  • Desejável conhecimento e interesse em soluções acionáveis de Inteligência Artificial para negócios e dados.
  • Inglês intermediário fundamental, para leitura, escrita e conversação.
  • Espanhol desejável.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua




Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!




Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience.   • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

title: DDI Network Engineer (LATAM)
description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are seeking DDI Network Engineers (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) to join a strategic, supply chain–level project with one of our key clients in the US, focused on migrating and reorganizing network records. This professional will play a key role in executing planned changes, ensuring operational continuity and the reliability of the network infrastructure.


Responsibilities

  • Perform migration of DNS/DHCP records, VLANs, and other network configurations across multiple sites.
  • Execute approximately four weekly changes (including weekend work when necessary).
  • Ensure stability, security, and availability of network services during and after changes.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and operations teams to align schedules and minimize impact on production environments.
  • Document processes, changes, and outcomes of each activity performed.
  • Contribute to best practices for DNS, DHCP, and IPAM (DDI) management and suggest continuous improvements.


Requirements

  • Proven experience with administration of DNS, DHCP, and IPAM (DDI) in corporate environments.
  • Solid knowledge of VLANs, TCP/IP, subnets, and network protocols .
  • Hands-on experience with IPAM management tools (e.g., Infoblox, BlueCat, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work on migration projects and large distributed environments.
  • Skilled at handling critical changes with tight windows (including weekends).
  • Technical English for documentation and communication with global teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in supply chain or large-scale network environments .
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Infoblox NIOS).
  • Previous experience in nearshore projects and collaboration with international teams.



"All vacancies at Grupo SONDA are extended to people with disabilities"

SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are seeking DDI Network Engineers (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) to join a strategic, supply chain–level project with one of our key clients in the US, focused on migrating and reorganizing network records. This professional will play a key role in executing planned changes, ensuring operational continuity and the reliability of the network infrastructure.


Responsibilities

  • Perform migration of DNS/DHCP records, VLANs, and other network configurations across multiple sites.
  • Execute approximately four weekly changes (including weekend work when necessary).
  • Ensure stability, security, and availability of network services during and after changes.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and operations teams to align schedules and minimize impact on production environments.
  • Document processes, changes, and outcomes of each activity performed.
  • Contribute to best practices for DNS, DHCP, and IPAM (DDI) management and suggest continuous improvements.


Requirements

  • Proven experience with administration of DNS, DHCP, and IPAM (DDI) in corporate environments.
  • Solid knowledge of VLANs, TCP/IP, subnets, and network protocols .
  • Hands-on experience with IPAM management tools (e.g., Infoblox, BlueCat, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work on migration projects and large distributed environments.
  • Skilled at handling critical changes with tight windows (including weekends).
  • Technical English for documentation and communication with global teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in supply chain or large-scale network environments .
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Infoblox NIOS).
  • Previous experience in nearshore projects and collaboration with international teams.



"All vacancies at Grupo SONDA are extended to people with disabilities"

title: Arquiteto/Tech Lead – Sistemas de Autorização (ISO 8583)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


O que esperamos que você realize:

Responsável por liderar a arquitetura, evolução técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos de autorização de transações financeiras, com foco em alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo a aderência aos padrões de mercado e a integração eficiente com sistemas de pagamento baseados no protocolo ISO 8583.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas de autorização financeira baseados em ISO 8583.
  • Liderar decisões técnicas e orientar o time no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Garantir a integração eficiente com terminais, adquirentes e emissores via mensagens ISO 8583.
  • Projetar e revisar modelos de dados em Oracle, otimizando consultas SQL e PL/SQL.
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de vida de aplicações em ambientes WebSphere e JBoss.
  • Promover a adoção de microserviços com Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Data e Security.
  • Estabelecer e manter pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps e infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Definir estratégias de conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Documentar e versionar APIs RESTful e SOAP com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Aplicar padrões de design e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Atuar como facilitador técnico em squads ágeis, promovendo colaboração e entrega contínua.

title: Python Developer
description:
Overview: At Algoseek, we are seeking a talented Python Developer with strong SQL expertise and basic DevOps knowledge to join our engineering team. You will play a key role in extending and maintaining a scalable, distributed OLAP database solution based on open-source engines. This role offers the opportunity to work on innovative data synchronization systems and APIs powering our financial data platform.


Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

Work Hours: 45 hours per week


Responsibilities:

  • Develop robust Python scripts to manage internal database files and synchronize client database machines with centralized data storage.
  • Design and implement APIs for data synchronization logic using FastAPI .
  • Contribute to the development of scalable and distributed OLAP database solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with existing systems.
  • Work with AWS services such as EC2 and S3 to support deployment and storage requirements.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Participate in code reviews and share technical knowledge with team members


Skills and Qualifications: 

  • 4+ years of professional experience in Python development.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience in database administration.
  • Familiarity with basic DevOps practices and tools.
  • Hands-on experience with API development using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Knowledge of AWS services (EC2, S3) is preferred.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git).


Technical Knowledge:

  • Programming Languages: Python
  • Frameworks: FastAPI (or similar Python web frameworks)
  • Databases: Databricks, Clickhouse, TimescaleDB
  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3)
  • DevOps: Basic understanding of deployment pipelines and server management
  • Version Control: Git


Professional Traits:

  • Effective problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team
  • Adaptable to changing requirements and priorities
  • Commitment to writing clean, maintainable code


Requirements: 

  • Proven experience developing Python-based solutions for data management and API integration.
  • Familiarity with distributed database architectures is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote setup.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.


Education: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)


What We Offer: 

  • Structured Career Path: Start with a hands-on internship, transition into a probationary role, and upon successful evaluation, move into full-time employment.
  • Long-Term Career Growth: Enjoy continuous salary progression based on your technical expertise and specialization—your earnings will grow as you deepen your knowledge.
  • Competitive Compensation: Potential to out-earn traditional management roles through specialization.
  • Hands-On Work: Focused on finance and data problem-solving, not management tasks.
  • Remote Setup: Flexible work environment allowing for global applicants.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE)

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.
  • Atuar em incidentes e ajudar a reduzir MTTR.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia usando melhores práticas em SRE;
  • Experiência em ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI ou AWS) ou híbridos;
  • Atuação com CI/CD (GitLab, ArgoCD e similares);
  • Experiência solida com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform e similares)
  • Automação e scripting (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell);
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel).
  • Domínio de containers e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering;
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Certificações em Cloud.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE)

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.
  • Atuar em incidentes e ajudar a reduzir MTTR.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia usando melhores práticas em SRE;
  • Experiência em ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI ou AWS) ou híbridos;
  • Atuação com CI/CD (GitLab, ArgoCD e similares);
  • Experiência solida com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform e similares)
  • Automação e scripting (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell);
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel).
  • Domínio de containers e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering;
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Certificações em Cloud.

description:

Somos uma software house focada em dar vida a ideias concebidas por startups em seus estágios iniciais e otimizar o fluxo de trabalho de empresas de médio/grande porte.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Backend Developer | WhatsApp Cloud API
description:
Vaga Desenvolvedor API/Backend


Estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora backend com experiência em Python / FastAPI para atuar no desenvolvimento de novas features e integrações de um SaaS de Inteligência Artificial.

Nosso produto é uma plataforma de Agentic AI, construída sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e voltada para empresas que desejam escalar conversas automatizadas e integrar canais, pagamentos e agenda em um só lugar.


Sobre a Bren


A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades


  • Evoluir o backend da plataforma (FastAPI + Google Cloud)
  • Integrar sistemas de terceiros no app (ex: fornecedores e gateways de pagamento, calendário Google e Outlook)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o resto do time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura)


Stack


  • Linguagem:  Python
  • Framework:  FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura:  Google Cloud Platform
  • Principal API externa:  WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência comprovada com APIs e integrações externas
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas escaláveis e microserviços
  • Experiência com Google Cloud (ou AWS/Azure equivalente)
  • Conhecimento em autenticação ( OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e queries de SQL
  • Experiência com API da Meta e Whatsapp Flow é um diferencial


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.


Estamos com a oportunidade Exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência para essa vaga.


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Apoiar no controle de contratos de transporte de colaboradores;
  • Auxiliar no controle de contratos de leasing, locação e aquisição de veículos;
  • Apoiar no processo de pagamentos de prestadores de serviços;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento das rotas de transporte de pessoal;
  • Realizar registros de passageiros dos ônibus da empresa;
  • Manter atualizado o inventário da frota;
  • Apoiar na gestão de manutenção dos veículos;
  • Apoiar na renovação de veículos junto às locadoras;
  • Atualizar informações no sistema corporativo;
  • apoiar em relatórios e controles orçamentários da frota;
  • Executar outras atividades sob orientação do seu superior;


Instrução:

  • Ensino Médio Completo


Desejável:

Técnico ou Superior em Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas e CNH Cat.B definitiva.


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:

title: Operations and Logistc Manager
description:
Key responsabilities:


-Coordinate the transportation and customs clearance of goods from the country of origin to our warehouse facilities.

-Manage inbound and outbound operations of our 3PL, ensuring timely and accurate processing of orders.

-Allocate stock to orders for wholesale distribution based on priorities and delivery windows.

-Forecast sales and communicate with sales teams regarding any potential delivery delays.

-Establish and Monitor SLAs and ensure compliance with established performance metrics.

-Provide world-class customer service to our clients, promptly addressing any inquiries or concerns.

-Lead and mentor a team responsible for executing logistics operations.


Must have:

-You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

-You bring proven solid experience in operations and logistics, preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment.

-You can thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

-You have leadership experience, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team towards achieving common goals.

-You understand import/export regulations and customs procedures well.

-Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field.


Note:

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Multinational in logistics

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status; nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity; strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month

title: MAWM Specialist (Label Design)
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Provide application support for Manhattan Active WM (MAWM) in production and non-production environments.
  • Design, configure, and customize labels (shipping labels, carton labels, pallet labels, compliance labels, etc.) using MAWM label design tools and third-party label management systems (e.g., Loftware, NiceLabel, Bartender ).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve label printing issues across multiple sites and printer models (Zebra, Honeywell, etc.).
  • Work with business teams to gather requirements for new label formats and implement them in MAWM.
  • Support daily warehouse operations – inbound, outbound, inventory, RF transactions, and reporting.
  • Manage integrations between MAWM and print servers (Loftware/NiceLabel/Bartender).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (ERP, TMS, automation, IT infrastructure) to resolve issues.
  • Participate in upgrades, enhancements, and change requests related to MAWM and labeling.
  • Document support activities, create SOPs, and provide training for warehouse teams.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in Manhattan Active WM (MAWM)
  • Strong hands-on experience in label designing tools such as Loftware, Bartender, NiceLabel .
  • Good understanding of warehouse processes – inbound, outbound, inventory, putaway, picking, shipping.
  • Knowledge of RF devices and label printer configurations .
  • Proficiency in SQL, Unix/Linux commands , and troubleshooting integrations.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Experience with incident/change management tools like ServiceNow or JIRA.

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative team. You will develop high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing directly to company-wide initiatives using exciting technologies such as Elixir , Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You’ll have a strong influence on technical decisions, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, and continuously improve your skills and our systems.


Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, performant, and testable code aligned with company initiatives
  • Develop using technologies like Elixir, Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka , AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decision-making shaping the software’s future
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate with team members on feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production
  • Partner with product and engineering management to deliver solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with reusable components and building component libraries
  • Understanding of production-ready web applications and systems
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement
  • Experience with any of: Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, Next.js, or other programming languages
  • Familiarity with tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and remote deployment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for problem-solving and curiosity about retail/e-commerce, high-end consignment market, and sustainable circular economy for luxury goods

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

title: Analista de Implantação Pleno - Protheus RH
description:
Sobre a empresa


Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.


#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS


Descrição da vaga


Como Analista de Implantação Protheus RH você será responsável por realizar implantação, sustentação e parametrização dos módulos de Recursos Humanos do ERP TOTVS Protheus. Sua atuação será de forma consultiva junto aos clientes internos e externos, garantindo que os processos estejam alinhados às práticas de gestão de pessoas e às exigências legais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Executar implantação e configuração dos módulos de RH do Protheus, incluindo: Folha de Pagamento, Ponto Eletrônico, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho (SIGAGPE/SIGAGPE-SST), Avaliação e Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH, Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos e mapeamento de processos junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Parametrizar o sistema conforme legislação vigente e políticas internas;
  • Acompanhar testes, homologações e treinamentos com usuários;
  • Propor melhorias e padronizações nos processos de gestão de pessoas via Protheus;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e funcional das implantações;
  • Apoiar a integração entre módulos de RH e outros ambientes TOTVS.


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou correlatas;
  • Experiência na implantação ou sustentação do Protheus RH;
  • Domínio dos módulos: Folha, Ponto, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança, Avaliação, Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH e Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Conhecimento em rotinas legais e obrigações acessórias (eSocial, DIRF, RAIS, CAGED, etc.);
  • Vivência em parametrizações, fórmulas, tabelas e eventos do Protheus;
  • Capacidade de analisar e propor soluções funcionais aderentes ao negócio,
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido.


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:


  • Experiência com integrações Fluig–Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em ADVPL (para acompanhamento técnico de customizações),
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação ou atualização de versão (UPDDISTR).


Benefícios


  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Analista de Implantação Pleno - Protheus RH
description:
Sobre a empresa


Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.


#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS


Descrição da vaga


Como Analista de Implantação Protheus RH você será responsável por realizar implantação, sustentação e parametrização dos módulos de Recursos Humanos do ERP TOTVS Protheus. Sua atuação será de forma consultiva junto aos clientes internos e externos, garantindo que os processos estejam alinhados às práticas de gestão de pessoas e às exigências legais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Executar implantação e configuração dos módulos de RH do Protheus, incluindo: Folha de Pagamento, Ponto Eletrônico, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho (SIGAGPE/SIGAGPE-SST), Avaliação e Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH, Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos e mapeamento de processos junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Parametrizar o sistema conforme legislação vigente e políticas internas;
  • Acompanhar testes, homologações e treinamentos com usuários;
  • Propor melhorias e padronizações nos processos de gestão de pessoas via Protheus;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e funcional das implantações;
  • Apoiar a integração entre módulos de RH e outros ambientes TOTVS.


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou correlatas;
  • Experiência na implantação ou sustentação do Protheus RH;
  • Domínio dos módulos: Folha, Ponto, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança, Avaliação, Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH e Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Conhecimento em rotinas legais e obrigações acessórias (eSocial, DIRF, RAIS, CAGED, etc.);
  • Vivência em parametrizações, fórmulas, tabelas e eventos do Protheus;
  • Capacidade de analisar e propor soluções funcionais aderentes ao negócio,
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido.


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:


  • Experiência com integrações Fluig–Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em ADVPL (para acompanhamento técnico de customizações),
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação ou atualização de versão (UPDDISTR).


Benefícios


  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Santa Catarina
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Business Analyst - AI Oriented
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about transforming information into actionable insights. You thrive at the intersection of business and technology, leveraging AI-powered analytics and automation to deliver smarter decision-making tools. You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to modernize data ecosystems and drive measurable business outcomes through predictive intelligence and efficiency.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Analysis or BI roles, preferably with a focus on AI-enhanced data solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, SQL, and advanced Excel (including automation and AI-powered functions).
  • Experience using BI tools such as Tableau or MicroStrategy, and working knowledge of ETL frameworks.
  • Proven track record in leading data integration projects, developing predictive models, and supporting executive-level reporting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, capable of translating business requirements into effective data solutions.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data environments and AI-driven analytics practices (nice to have).
  • English Full Professional Proficiency.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement AI-driven dashboards and data models using Power BI, SQL, and Excel to support predictive analytics and performance optimization.
  • Manage end-to-end BI modernization initiatives, including data warehouse expansion, ETL automation, and AI capability integration.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data solutions in collaboration with data engineering and technology teams.
  • Develop and optimize automated reporting workflows to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring timely delivery of analytics projects and reports.
  • Support executive-level reporting by delivering real-time insights that enhance decision-making across campaign tracking, financial planning, and strategic initiatives.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve reporting, visualization, and data accessibility.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Senior Go Engineer
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior Go Engineer. You will be responsible for leading the development of web applications using Go. You’ll work on the back-end, focusing on delivering efficient, scalable, and robust solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members to ensure seamless integration between the front-end and back-end.
  • Build efficient, reusable, and scalable code while following best practices for security and performance.
  • Develop RESTful APIs to power front-end applications and third-party integrations.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to the team.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure the quality of the applications.


Technology Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer.
  • Deep understanding of Go programming language, including concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels), memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Experience building and deploying scalable and resilient backend services and APIs using Go frameworks (e.g., Gin, Echo, Fiber).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Extensive experience with Playwright for end-to-end testing of web applications is a plus.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, and maintain robust and reliable automated test suites.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Previous experience with high volume, high scale distributed systems.
  • Experience working with integration of payment processing platforms, design, develop and optimize API connections to enable smooth payment workflows.
  • Understanding of cloud-native architectures and best practices.

title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Location: Brazil/ Remote

Job Type: Full-time contract



About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.



Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.



About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.


What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.



Key Responsibilities


, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.


Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.


Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.


Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.



Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.



Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions
